narration: That countdown timer on your screen isn't real. Seventy-three percent of online retailers fake them — and here's what that one trick is actually costing you.
visual: Fake product deal page with large red countdown timer ticking down (9:47...), 'ONLY 2 LEFT IN STOCK' warning flashing in red, product box SVG with amber price tag. Dark background.

narration: Here's the science. That ticking clock triggers your amygdala — your brain's fear center — in under 340 milliseconds. Your wallet opens before you even think.
visual: SVG brain diagram on light background, amygdala region glowing red and pulsing, panic signals radiating outward, '340ms' counter animating upward. Label: 'FEAR CENTER: ACTIVATED'.

narration: And the scale is wild. Amazon runs 200,000 Lightning Deals a year — every single one with a ticking clock. That one trick generates twelve billion dollars annually.
visual: Large amber lightning bolt SVG, '$12B' counter animating upward on dark background, small deal cards with red timers appearing beneath it. Text: '200,000 DEALS/YEAR'.

narration: When urgency kicks in, you make 23 percent more impulse purchases. For the average American, that adds up to $2,800 a year you never planned to spend.
visual: Wallet SVG with money arrows flowing out on light background, bar chart growing to $2,800 with red fill, '23%' stat animating in below. Counter: $0 → $2,800.

narration: Here's the fix. When you feel that urgency, wait 24 hours. The deal will almost always still be there — or a better one will appear. Screenshot the timer and check back.
visual: Countdown timer with large green X crossing it out on dark background, SVG calendar with '24H' highlighted day. Checkmark SVG animating in. Text: 'THE DEAL WILL STILL BE THERE'.

narration: Next time you see that ticking clock, screenshot it and come back tomorrow. You'll catch the fake almost every time. Follow for more retail tricks they don't want you to know.
visual: Phone SVG showing screenshot capture flash, 'SCREENSHOT TAKEN' badge in green, reminder notification set for 24 hours. '↑ FOLLOW' text bouncing up in amber. Dark background.
